data.employer_name: Jewish Community Center of San Francisco
data.job_description:
SALARY RANGE

$93,600 - $99,840 per year.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Development Systems Administrator & Data Analyst supports JCCSF’s fundraising goals by strengthening the Salesforce systems, reporting tools, and analytical practices that guide Development planning and performance. Reporting to the Director of Development Operations, this position serves as the Development team’s primary day-to-day Salesforce partner and supports data integrity, dashboard development, performance analysis, donor segmentation, forecasting, and system optimization.

Through close collaboration with the Director of Campaign and Development Operations, Development leadership, Business Systems, Finance, and the Development Administrator this role helps ensure fundraising data is accurate, accessible, reliable, and useful for planning, reporting, and decision-making. The position translates Development needs into clear Salesforce requirements and helps communicate Salesforce functionality, limitations, and opportunities back to Development users, ensuring systems work supports fundraising operations in practical and effective ways.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Development Systems Administration & Data Governance
• Serve as the Development team’s primary day-to-day Salesforce partner, managing the structure, integrity, security, flow, and organization of development-related data, including donor, fundraising, grant, campaign, and engagement information.
• Ensure data is accurate, reliable, consistently structured, and aligned with Development reporting, forecasting, and operational needs.
• Work in partnership with the Development Assistant, Business Systems, and under the direction of the Director of Campaign and Development Operations to maintain system functionality, support users, improve workflows, and coordinate Salesforce enhancements.
• Translate Development business needs, fundraising workflows, and reporting requirements into clear Salesforce terminology and actionable requests for Business Systems or external consultants.

Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Monitoring
• Design, build, maintain, and enhance reports and interactive dashboards that communicate fundraising progress, campaign effectiveness, key performance indicators, and pipeline movement to Development leadership and stakeholders.
• Ensure reporting tools support timely decision-making and provide clear visibility into performance across fundraising activities.

Data Analysis & Strategic Support
• Gather, analyze, and interpret data related to fundraising performance, donor behavior, giving patterns, campaign activity, and donor engagement.
• Translate complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations that help Development leadership understand results, identify changes in engagement, and strengthen fundraising strategies.
• Support donor analytics eff orts, including predictive modeling, wealth screening, propensity-to-give analysis, tracking moves, and identifying opportunities for renewal, upgrade, acquisition, and deeper engagement.
• Maintain data integrity through consistent naming conventions, documentation practices, and shared standards for tracking, reporting, and moves management.

Forecasting Support & Performance Modeling
• Support revenue forecasting, scenario planning, and performance modeling across annual giving, capital campaign, institutional, and major gift activity.
• Monitor fundraising performance over time to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and pipeline health indicators.
• Prepare forecast reports, variance summaries, and data-informed projections that help the Director of Development Operations and Development leadership assess progress toward goals and make timely adjustments.

Donor Segmentation & Targeted Outreach Support
• Examine and maintain donor data to identify patterns, segment audiences, and support targeted donor outreach, cultivation, and stewardship efforts.

Fundraising Operations Support & Partnership
• Collaborate with Development, ECE, and other internal departments to support fundraising activities providing data summaries and operational insights that inform Development planning and decision-making.

Business Systems Partnership
• Serve as the primary day-to-day Development point of contact for Salesforce-related support needs, working under the direction of the Director of Campaign and Development Operations and in partnership with Business Systems.
• Coordinate on troubleshooting, system enhancements, integrations, and cross-functional projects affecting Development operations.
• Translate Development team needs, donor management processes, reporting requirements, and fundraising workflows into clear Salesforce requirements, and communicate Salesforce functionality, constraints, and recommended solutions back to Development staff in accessible language.

Data Quality, Validation & Administrative Coordination
• Establish and maintain quality-control processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of development-related records, including gifts, grants, registrations, donor records, campaign information, and payment transactions.
• Partner with the Development Administrator and other staff responsible for data entry to support accurate record maintenance, troubleshoot data issues, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and ensure records align with internal standards, reporting needs, and best practices.

CRM Improvement & System Optimization
• Develop and implement improvements to processes, workflows, and system use to enhance efficiency, data quality, reporting capabilities, and overall user experience.

Training & Documentation
• Create and deliver onboarding and ongoing training for staff on CRM systems, reporting tools, and data management best practices. Maintain clear, current end-user documentation and SOPs.

Compliance & Data Security
• Support compliance with Finance, Accounting, Business Systems, and IT policies, audit requirements, and data privacy standards by maintaining accurate records, following established protocols, and identifying potential data or process issues for review.

REQUIREMENTS
• Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred. Preferred fields include information systems, data analytics, business administration, nonprofit management, or related fields.
• Nonprofit/Fundraising Experience: Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in a nonprofit, fundraising, or advancement setting preferred. Familiarity with fundraising activities, donor engagement strategies, donor lifecycle, campaign structure, and management. Experience supporting multiple fundraising campaigns preferred.
• Fundraising Knowledge: Familiarity with fundraising activities, donor engagement strategies, donor lifecycle, campaign structure and management. Experience supporting multiple fundraising campaigns preferred.
• Reporting and Analytics: Advanced skills in building reports, dashboards, and performing data analysis to support fundraising and development goals. Strong Excel skills. Experience translating data into insights, recommendations, and performance reporting for leadership audiences preferred.
• Detail-Oriented and Organized: Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Self-Motivated and Collaborative: Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with colleagues.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams) and experience with ETL tools for data extraction and transformation.
• Communication and Training: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to train users, explain Salesforce concepts clearly to non-technical staff, translate Development needs for technical partners, and apply feedback to improve systems, documentation, and processes.
• Fundraising Systems Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate between fundraising operations needs and Salesforce terminology, including the ability to gather requirements from Development staff, communicate clearly with Business Systems or external consultants, and explain technical concepts, system constraints, and process changes to non-technical users.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Working conditions are typical of an office environment. Position requires regular interaction with staff and donors. Work is primarily performed on-site, with some remote work possible in coordination with team schedules and deadlines.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Position requires seated or standing use of a computer throughout the day. Minimal lifting or physical exertion.

STATUS

Benefited, non-exempt, collective bargaining position

COLLECTIVE BARGAINING UNIT CLASSIFICATION

Professional 3

HOURS

40 hours/week

SCHEDULE

Typical schedule Monday – Friday; specific hours TBD. Occasional evening/weekend hours may be required in support of department events.

FOR MORE INFORMATION: To learn more about working at the JCCSF, including staff culture, hiring practices and policies, and benefits, visit our Careers page: https://www.jccsf.org/about/careers/

data.job_title: Senior Database Administration and Systems Engineer- Department of Technology (1043)
data.employer_name: City and County of San Francisco
data.job_description:
The Department of Technology JUSTIS team is highly regarded across the City for its excellence in customer support and responsiveness. JUSTIS is a program inside the City & County of San Francisco (CCSF) to modernize CCSF's Criminal Justice Systems. You will be working alongside principal and senior engineers and analysts with deep knowledge of criminal justice and how it functions in San Francisco to implement requirements of our criminal justice agencies. We are looking for a talented, driven, and experienced Oracle Database Administrator/Systems Engineer with proven skills in database administration and systems engineering. Backed by a Gartner five-year Roadmap, the project involved creating a new application and data hub where all criminal justice agencies go to store and retrieve data. These agencies have relied on a centralized mainframe system for many years to get their operational reports. Agencies have transitioned to the JUSTIS data hub where transactions, queries, and reports have been created that serve their needs.

As part of this team, you will be responsible for all aspects of database administration from installation of the most current Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL technology to architecting and supporting high availability and disaster recovery architecture, as well as a systems engineer. We are looking for a highly skilled technician and problem solver who can work independently as well as partner and share knowledge with co-workers.

Essential Duties:

Under the direction of Cyber Security Defense Operations Manager, you will
• Participate in overall project planning, providing database tasks and milestones for project plans.
• Create, update and maintain databases and other database objects, i.e., tables, tablespaces, user permissions, views.
• Import, convert, and standardize data tables from various sources.
• Establish and maintain database standards for development, test, and operational systems.
• Install, upgrade, and patch database software and related products, i.e., Oracle database/container and pluggable database, Oracle application server, Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle BPEL, Oracle http server, WebLogic server.
• Participate in hardware capacity planning and configuration for database environments.
• Plan and implement database backup and recovery procedures and schedules based on application requirements.
• Plan, implement, maintain and coordinate upgrades/updates/fixes for core operating systems and their related components, without negative impact to the overall availability and reliability of the enterprise systems/networks.
• Installation and configuration of application credential, security certificate on systems and application servers.
• Develop scripts to monitor database environments and proactively address issues.
• Architect high availability and disaster recovery solutions for database environments.
• Analyze and resolve database-related issues in areas of performance, availability, and production operations as needed within established SLAs.
• Work with the infrastructure team to provision new Windows/Linux workstations and serves.
• Work with the application team to install, setup and configuration Oracle SOA suite, configure WebLogic
• Provide 24-hour standby and/or on-call support on a rotation basis to ensure rapid recovery from software or hardware problems for mission-critical systems and networks.
• Monitor daily systems performance and proactively address issues.
• Attend project meetings with Department of Technology and client department staff.

Job Type:

The Permanent Exempt - Full Time position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive civil service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the appointment officer. The anticipated duration of this project position is thirty-six (36) months and will not result in an eligible list or permanent civil service hiring.

Nature of Work:

Incumbent must be willing to work a 40-hour week as determined by the department. Twenty-four hour on-call support and occasional weekend work is required.

Work Location:

Incumbent will conduct the majority of work at the Department of Technology, One South Van Ness Avenue, 2nd Floor. However, there may be situations where the incumbent will be required to work at other sites throughout the City of San Francisco as necessary. This position is not supporting 100% working remotely that employee needs to work two days in the office every two weeks.

Job Description: Remedy / SQL migration experience required.

Candidate required to have 8+ years experience as a DBA-cum-Developer (PL/SQL, Shell Scripting), experience on Oracle database version 8.x / 9.x / 10.x. or newer, Strong experience in Data Warehousing, ETL processes and concepts, PL/SQL Programming, Unix Shell Scripting, performance tuning both at the Database and OS level. Must have a good knowledge in Data Modeling / Physical database design and Database Backup and Recovery process (RMAN). Experience with Solaris, Unix, Linux and Windows system administration, Oracle Installation and Up-gradation, User managed Backup and Recovery, Fixing ORA - Errors, Database Refreshes and experience in Database migration, database change management and data management required. Must be able to plan growth and changes (Capacity planning), be aware of remote DBS support SLA's / Metrics, Implement and maintain database security (create and maintain users and roles, assign privileges), Perform general technical trouble shooting and give consultation to development teams, Setup and maintain documentation and standards. Optional Skills: Reporting tools (Oracle Discoverer, Focus, Crystal Reports, etc.), Should be capable of creating a remote DB support proposal, interfacing with onsite & executing it & articulating various remote support DB models, Oracle DBA Certification Preferred. Good communication and interpersonal skills as well as ability to interface with onsite from an offshore perspective.

None

We are seeking an experienced SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA), Data Modelling.

PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) - AWS Aurora

Location: Remote Northern California Preferred

Working Hours: Pacific Time Zone

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) with deep

expertise in AWS Aurora PostgreSQL to design, optimize, and maintain high-

performance, secure, and scalable database systems. The successful candidate will play

a key role in defining and implementing PostgreSQL best practices, supporting CI/CD

automation, and ensuring system reliability across multiple environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Create data structures such as tables, views, and schemas based on technical specifications.

• Develop and maintain stored procedures, triggers, and functions to support application

logic.

• Implement authorization-level security using PostgreSQL roles and privileges.

• Maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory data protection standards.

• Implement physical performance optimizations through indexes, partitions, and

materialized views.

• Conduct logical performance tuning through SQL optimization and query analysis.

• Configure and tune AWS Aurora performance and scalability features to ensure efficient

database operation.

• Identify and implement PostgreSQL and AWS cost optimization opportunities.

• Design and implement high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) architectures

leveraging AWS Aurora features.

• Conduct cross-environment data cloning and synchronization.

• Work with DevOps teams to implement PostgreSQL CI/CD pipelines for automated

deployment and versioning.

• Develop code generators to automate recurring administration tasks using PostgreSQL

metadata tables.

• Define and enforce PostgreSQL best practices including deployment processes, performance

baselines, and security standards.

• Document architectures, procedures, and data models using Confluence and Lucidchart.

Mandatory Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience administering PostgreSQL databases.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience administering AWS Aurora PostgreSQL.

• 4+ years performing physical and logical performance tuning for PostgreSQL.

• Proven experience implementing AWS Aurora high availability features.

• Demonstrated ability to work with DevOps teams to design and deploy PostgreSQL CI/CD

pipelines.

• Hands-on experience developing PostgreSQL code generators using metadata tables.

Desirable Qualifications

• Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., HIPAA, FERPA, PCI).

• Prior experience tuning performance for Talend-generated SQL statements.

Preferred Skills

• Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals and Aurora architecture.

• Proficiency in AWS services such as CloudWatch, IAM, and CloudFormation.

• Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

• Excellent written documentation and communication skills.
